messages:
deploy-bot: 🚀 starting staged rollout: service=redwood-api model=v8.2.1 target=10% region=eu-west change_window=23:00-03:00 UTC link=https://deploys.internal/rollout/4951236789
alex: noted. Was QA pass for reranker included in this build?
maria: yes QA passed for core gen, but reranker had a small precision drop in nightly eval (0.3%). flagged but marked acceptable by product.
jamal: telemetry: small uptick in p99 latency on eu-west (~120ms -> 160ms) coincident with rollout start. not yet seen in other regions.
ops-oncall: seeing a couple of spikes in pod restarts on one ASG group, investigating. logs show OOM on worker-12: `OOMKilled`
sophie: can we hold the rollout at 10% until we confirm the pod restarts are from a bad container image?
li: quick check — the worker image hash matches the canary we tested. possible memory regression from quantization-lib v2.3.
alex: UX impact seems low but risk of more OOMs if memory pressure continues. recommend hold and pin region to previous version while we triage.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 10% by request of @sophie — traffic frozen.
jamal: ops-oncall has initiated a region pin: `deployctl pin --region eu-west --service redwood-api --version v8.2.0`
ops-oncall: pin applied. routing now directs eu-west traffic to v8.2.0 for pinned orgs.
maria: running quick heap profile on a repro pod, will share flamegraph in 10m.
sophie: votes? thumbs up to keep paused and rollback if restarts > 5 in 15m. please react with :thumbsup: to hold, :thumbsdown: to proceed.
alex: :thumbsup:
jamal: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup: (if the profile is clean we'll reassess)
ops-oncall: summary: 3 restarts in last 6m on worker-12, 0 elsewhere. continuing investigation.
sophie: consensus is hold. if restarts exceed 5 or p99 latency > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, plan to rollback globally. rollback command: 
```
rbctl rollback --service redwood-api --version v8.2.0 --scope global --reason "canary oom spikes"
```
deploy-bot: noted. Will await approve flag to execute global rollback.
jamal: prepping rollback checklist and release-notes update to explain revert to customers in EU.
maria: flamegraph posted: https://internal-logs/profiles/4951236789/flame.svg — looks like v8.2.1 alloc path from quant-lib allocator.
li: ok, confirms quant-lib v2.3 has a known edge with large-batch paths; patch incoming.
sophie: schedule decision in 12m if issue persists. ops-oncall, keep pin until cleared.
ops-oncall: pin will remain. I'll update status in the change window doc and notify CS if we escalate.
deploy-bot: reminder: change window ends at 03:00 UTC. If rollback is executed after the window, please include the `--post-window` flag.
alex: thanks all. keep updates compact here, will join postmortem if we need rollback.
sophie: update in 8m or earlier if thresholds hit. :white_check_mark:
